entries.name: discus throw
entries.definition: Competitors stand in a netted circle with a 2.50 metres diameter and with a turning motion attempt to throw a discus weighing 2kg for men and 1kg for women as far as possible. The longest throw wins.

entries.name: hammer throw
entries.definition: Competitors throw a hammer consisting of a metal ball, chain and handle as far as they can from a netted circle which is 2.13 metres in diameter. The hammer weighs 7.26 kg for men and 4 kg for women.

entries.name: javelin throw
entries.definition: Competitors in a specially-designated throwing area attempt to fling a spear-like javelin as far as possible. The javelin weighs 800 grammes for men and 600 grammes for women.

entries.name: decathlon

entries.name: skeleton
entries.definition: In skeleton the competitor lays on his/hers stomach when racing down the course. The competitor must be on the sled when crossing the finishing line. The total time of all races in a competition is added together.

entries.name: Australian rules football
entries.definition: Football played under Australian rules

entries.name: Canadian football
entries.definition: Football played under Canadian rules

entries.name: duathlon
entries.definition: Duathlon

entries.name: hornuss
entries.definition: Swiss team sport with 16 or 18 men per team. A rubber puck is hit towards the field of the adversary team which tries to hit the puck in the air with a wooden board thrown in the air

entries.name: fist ball
entries.definition: Men's team sport similar to volleyball (with a much lower net) executed mainly in gymnastics clubs

entries.name: inline skating
entries.definition: Competitive sports using inline skates

entries.name: grass ski
entries.definition: Alpine skiing on roller skis and grass

entries.name: snowbiking
entries.definition: Individual sport on snow on a snow bike, the athlete has two mini skis, previous name: ski bob

entries.name: twirling
entries.definition: Team competition with majorettes and a jury

entries.name: kendo
entries.definition: Japanese traditional martial art using a bamboo sword, sometimes called Japanese fencing. (Programme of National Sports Festival in Japan)

entries.name: jukendo
entries.definition: Japanese traditional martial art using a model rifle made of wood. *Juken* means a rifle or gun with blade (bayonet). (Programme of National Sports Festival in Japan)

entries.name: naginata
entries.definition: Japanese traditional martial art using a pole sword made of wood. *Naginata* means a spear with a curved blade. (Programme of National Sports Festival in Japan)

entries.name: kyudo
entries.definition: Japanese traditional martial art using a bamboo bow and arrows, sometimes called Japanese archery. (Programme of National Sports Festival in Japan)

entries.name: kabaddi
entries.definition: The attacking side scores by touching, and the side to guard scores by capturing. The attacker continues calling it *kabaddi*.

entries.name: sepak takraw
entries.definition: The game like volleyball which must not use a hand. The ball made of rattan is used. (Programme of National Sports Festival in Japan)

entries.name: wushu
entries.definition: Generally, Chinese traditional martial art. (Programme of National Sports Festival in Japan)

entries.name: darts
entries.definition: Two players compete by throwing metal darts at a wall-mounted circular board divided radially into segments of different scores

entries.name: bodybuilding
entries.definition: A person displays pronounced muscle tone and exaggerated muscle mass and definition for overall aesthetic effect

entries.name: sports disciplinary action
entries.definition: Actions, including fines and suspensions levied by sports organisations and teams

entries.name: sports awards
entries.definition: Awards and honors given by sports organisations or won by sports figures

entries.name: unrest, conflicts and war
entries.definition: Acts of socially or politically motivated protest and/or violence.

entries.name: act of terror
entries.definition: Act of violence, often deadly, designed to raise fear and anxiety in a population

entries.name: armed conflict
entries.definition: Disputes between opposing groups involving the use of weaponry, but not formally declared a war

entries.name: civil unrest
entries.definition: Dissatisfaction among the general population as evidenced by rallies, strikes, demonstrations or sabotage

entries.name: revolutions
entries.definition: An often violent change in a nation's system of government by internal forces that results in systematic social change.

entries.name: rebellions
entries.definition: Armed uprising by citizens of a nation with the intent to overthrow the government, without necessarily achieving social change

entries.name: political dissent
entries.definition: Disagreement between political groups, usually organized and sometimes resulting in imprisonment of the dissenters

entries.name: religious conflict
entries.definition: Conflicts involving religious differences

entries.name: social conflict
entries.definition: Conflicts involving social differences

entries.name: coup d'etat
entries.definition: The overthrow of an established government by an organized group, often the military or a political party

entries.name: guerrilla activity
entries.definition: Anti-government actions by clandestine groups using hit-and-run techniques or sabotage, kidnapping and the like

entries.name: bioterrorism
entries.definition: Use of biological agent to raise the level of fear within a population, whether deaths occur or not.

entries.name: bombings
entries.definition: Use of explosive devices against people, buildings or structures

entries.name: massacre
entries.definition: The death of a large group of people over a brief period of time

entries.name: genocide
entries.definition: Systematic killing of one clan, tribe or ethnic type by another

entries.name: riots
entries.definition: Violent, destructive demonstrations often involving injury to individuals and destruction of property

entries.name: demonstration
entries.definition: A public show of feeling or opinion, as by a mass meeting or parade

entries.name: war
entries.definition: A formal declaration of hostilities by one country against another

entries.name: civil war
entries.definition: Armed conflict between members of the same nation or geographical region, in some cases with a desire to divide the nation or region.

entries.name: international military intervention
entries.definition: Temporary use of international forces by invitation or by a decision of an outside body in another country or region for the purpose of resolving a crisis.

entries.name: prisoners and detainees
entries.definition: People captured and imprisoned by their enemy during war or armed conflict

entries.name: conflict (general)
entries.definition: A dispute which can be at several levels,

entries.name: peacekeeping force
entries.definition: Varied national military forces under unified international command to maintain order in disputed areas.

entries.name: crisis
entries.definition: Conflict of all kinds that rises to a level where, depending on events, governments can fall, war be declared or stock markets crash, or not

entries.name: weaponry
entries.definition: Armaments of all types used to conduct war

entries.name: weather
entries.definition: The study, reporting and prediction of meteorological phenomena.

entries.name: forecast
entries.definition: Prediction of the course of the weather in the future either near term or long term

entries.name: global change
entries.definition: The determination whether the Earth is getting warm, or colder, whether seas are rising or falling and the like

entries.name: report
entries.definition: Any distributed announcement about the weather

entries.name: weather news
entries.definition: General information about weather events

entries.name: statistic
entries.definition: Numerical facts about the weather such as temperature, barometric pressure, river levels, humidity, high and low tides and the like

entries.name: warning
entries.definition: Alerts to the general populace about severe weather coming their way
